# Educa Fintech

> Smart Fintech & Micro-Lending Platform. 12% Annual Interest on Savings Account, Instant ₹199 Recharge Loans, and Education/Vehicle Financing without CIBIL barriers.

## Core Products & Services

- **12% Annual Interest Savings Account**: Flat 12% APY calculated daily, zero minimum balance requirement, instant 24x7 withdrawal.
- **Micro Recharge Loans**: Instant ₹199 mobile recharge loan disbursed directly via UPI with zero CIBIL check.
- **Bike & Two-Wheeler Loans**: Financing up to ₹1,50,000 with flexible EMI options up to 36 months.
- **School & Tuition Fee Financing**: Dedicated educational loans for students and parents.
- **Virtual Credit Cards**: Silver & VIP Platinum virtual cards with reward points and security controls.

## Website & Access
- Official Website: https://educaintech.vercel.app
- Account Type: Free zero-balance account opening
